notes.title: 'Spring Outbreak' Update
notes.notes:
"Spring Outbreak" Update for Market Dominion is a huge update, including quite huge changes in events and map mechanics! This version, also known as 1.03. Update includes some interesting stuff!

[h2]MAP CHANGES[/h2]
Map has changed! Until now, there was only one map type: the plain, very basic map. Now, there was another map type added. It looks a bit... different. Fancy, to be exact! You can see it yourself underneath.
Both of those map types also received a "cycled" version of it, where map slowly changes into more "darker" scenario. In total, there are 4 map types now, which you can set up in the options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34143738/38b085ee70222840262554eceb4766d9ba92f039.png[/img]

[h2]EVENTS[/h2]
Events! Events has changed! Now, the game has almost 50 new events with new, unique theme. The events' topics are mostly based around various epidemics and economic crisis that happened around the world throughout the time of the game. It also includes several smaller, social events, as well as some symbollic ones. The reasoning behind it is to put the player on more dangerous path, forcing him to always have a back up plan if something doesn't go his way. In summary, game is more surprising now! Those events are also expected to raise awareness how some of the events might be destructive for humanity. Some of the events included are:
- cholera pandemic,
- Swine Flu pandemic,
- COVID-19 pandemic,
- Green New Deal,
- 2008 Crisis,
- Hong Kong Transfer,
- series of events about population rise.
Full list will be available soon on Gamepedia.

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
We fixed several bugs that were showing up, such as:
- inproper setup of 'Colours Mode' option (the option would reset upon relaunching the game)
- in the late-game random events about cargo transport were simply "unavailable", as the game run out of places to send player to. It was patched - now player receives 0,5% Market Share whenever there are no states left to go to.


[h2]CHANGES - FULL LIST[/h2]
[list]
[*] added map types,
[*] added cycled map modes, where map changes over time,
[*] added new series of 41 events (full list available on Gamepedia),
[*] Colours Mode Option did not save up properly in game options,
[*] added Map Type Option,
[*] fixed a bug with unavailable random cargo events,
[*] cosmetic changes to XML files,
[*] cosmetic changes to language files.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.02.4 Market Dominion Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello CEOs![/h1]

It is time for a bit bigger Market Dominion update. We have made several crucial changes and we released them as an update for the game now. What exactly has changed?

[h2]DLC Menu[/h2]
Downloadable Content menu has changed. From now it is... more pleasing to look at, as well as  it is more functional. We have introduced new mechanics to handle the DLCs, to have everything ready for upcoming DLCs. Other than that, we changed the way this menu works. If you want to have a closer look and read more about it, you should look at the most recent 'Dev Minutes' post [url=https://www.iguanamercenary.com/articles/dev-minutes-16-new-dlc-screen]here[/url].

[h2]Colours Mechanics[/h2]
We have also changed the colours mechanics. We have changed the colours available in the palette, as well as expanded it from 12 to 24 colours. New colours are not available in the standard game type though, they are reserved for something else. We have added colours modes as well. From now, you can pick a colour mode in which you'll play. You can change it and it will still change in your past saves (it might have some issues with older saves though). The standard palette is available as default, but you can also pick "Vision Defect" mode, which decreases the alpha value change on the map throughout the game, so you have less details to register. It is mainly for people who care about the visibility in the game more as well as might have some issues to view the standard colours mode. There is also "Deuteranomaly" mode which not only includes the "Vision Defect" mode in it, but also has a new colour palette, designed in a way, that people with deuteranomaly colourblindness can see the map and tell the companies apart easier. You can read more about it in previous 'Dev Minutes' [url=https://www.iguanamercenary.com/articles/dev-minutes-15-colours-mechanics-change]here[/url].

That would be mainly it for this update, stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've updated the game to address some bug issues people were having. Below is a list of all the changes.
[h1]1.02.2 Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] added a message when specialists do not have any more upgrades
[*] added a notification when the game is saved
[*] saves are now sorted by date (now saves are sorted by newest saves)
[*] fixed issue with loading save files (should add some backwards compatibility to your saves, so check out if your old saves are loading!)
[*] fixed a bug where slots are permanently occupied after saving the game
[*] fixed a bug where saves were deleted after the update
[*] fixed a bug where switching between languages would cause the save names to be replaced with "MODIFIER" text
[*] fixed a bug where menu load screen was broken on higher resolutions
[*] fixed a bug where you could continue to buy upgrades that are not available anymore
[*] fixed issue with specialists costs
[*] fixed extra options in game setup
[*] fixed an error while playing the game in Polish
[/list]

notes.title: Market Dominion Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello! Devs here!

We are happy to announce that our indie game, Market Dominion, [b]will be available for puchase on Steam on 7th of August 2019, Wednesday at 5AM PDT (2PM CEST, 10PM AEST).[/b]

Minimum Requirements:
- OS: Windows 7 64-bit
- Processor: Intel Pentium Dual Core
- Memory: 2GB RAM
- Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce MX150
- Storage: 150MB available space (estimated)

Available languages:
- English
- Polish
- Russian
- German (partial translation in the day of release)

notes.title: Release of the game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Devs here!


We are working on the game for the whole time to release it soon. The planned date of release is in July, after Steam Summer Sale.

Official beta testings are ending this week, and I would like to thank all of our testers for their effort and hope for the most detailed feedback, so we can improve the game even further. We have improved the game map, reworked the UI and we plan on adding more things that were either our idea or were suggested by our testers. We are really proud to have such a progress and we hope to release as soon as possible!
